save.title: Save current view
save.description: Saves the view type, filters, sort, grouping and search on screen. Each person who opens a shared view sees only what their own access allows.
save.name: Name
save.nameRequired: Name the view to save it.

share.title: Share {name}
share.description: People you share with can open the view, never edit it, and see only the records their own access allows.
share.noTeams: This organization has no teams yet. Create teams in Settings to share with them.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: The view is removed for you and for everyone it is shared with. The records it showed are not affected.

status.defaultCleared: This page now opens on its own default view.

errors.denied: You cannot change this view. Only its owner edits, shares or deletes it.
errors.invalid: This view cannot be saved as it stands. Check the name and try again.
errors.conflict: A view with these settings already exists. Pick another name.
errors.notFound: The view no longer exists or is no longer shared with you. Reload to see current views.
errors.unexpected: Saved views could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
errors.loadFailed: Saved views could not be loaded. The page still works; try the menu again shortly.

open.projectSentence: This view opens inside a project. Open the project, then choose the view from its view menu.
